full_judgment: (iii) The primary reason behind the fall in NAV in the 2nd report from that in the 1st report was the loss in operation. The retained earnings of the Petitioner No.2 Company fell to Taka 64,842,414 on 30 June 2022 from Taka 176,416,646 as on 31 December 2020 i.e. by Taka 111,574,232 due to a cumulative loss after tax and reversal of revaluation adjustment. The loss was caused by low sales and disposal of inventory. The inventory had to be disposed of as wastage because of the deterioration of its quality to be used in production process.
